input.message:
Run the full triage pipeline on this security alert: Phase 1 — Classify as TRUE_POSITIVE, FALSE_POSITIVE, or SUSPICIOUS with confidence 0-100. Phase 2 — If confidence >= 40, enrich with entity context (risk scores, baselines, relationships). Phase 3 — If still ambiguous (confidence 40-69), conduct structured threat hunt. Phase 4 — If TRUE_POSITIVE or SUSPICIOUS with confidence >= 50, check for attack chain correlation
           using security.attack_discovery_search.

Produce multi-dimensional classification. Respond with STRICT JSON (no prose):
{
  "classification":     "TRUE_POSITIVE" | "FALSE_POSITIVE" | "SUSPICIOUS",
  "confidence":         0-100,
  "disposition":        "TRUE_POSITIVE" | "BENIGN_TRUE_POSITIVE" | "FALSE_POSITIVE"
                       | "POLICY_VIOLATION" | "INCONCLUSIVE" | "DUPLICATE",
  "threat_category":    "commodity_malware" | "targeted_attack" | "insider_threat" | "misuse"
                       | "unauthorized_access" | "data_exfiltration" | "lateral_movement"
                       | "persistence" | "reconnaissance" | "unknown",
  "kill_chain_stage":   "reconnaissance" | "weaponization" | "delivery" | "exploitation"
                       | "installation" | "c2" | "actions_on_objectives" | "unknown",
  "business_impact":    { "data_at_risk": [...], "systems_at_risk": [...], "criticality": "low|medium|high|critical" },
  "recommended_action": "close_fp" | "open_case" | "enrich_only" | "escalate",
  "reasoning":          "<concise rationale>",
  "evidence":           [ { "summary": "...", "source_ref": "<doc id|query>", "confidence": 0.0-1.0 } ]
}
Self-validate: every field above MUST be populated. `disposition` MUST be one of the enumerated values (never "triaged" or other placeholders). `confidence` MUST be an integer 0-100.
